extracted.intended_audience: extramural grantee institutions' administrative staff (Signing Officials, PD/PIs) and Grants Management users who prepare and submit RPPRs via eRA Commons
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing, routing, approving, and electronically submitting Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPRs) using the eRA Commons RPPR module, including interim and final RPPRs and delegation rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with Non-Competing Continuation Progress Report Policy and RPPR Guide Notice
rubrics_metrics.description: RPPR submissions must follow the Non-Competing Continuation Progress Report Policy and the RPPR Guide Notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the policy and RPPR Guide Notice linked on the RPPR module page for applicable requirements and any policy updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of the RPPR module for electronic initiation
rubrics_metrics.description: Initiate the Research Performance Progress Report electronically via the eRA Commons RPPR module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access the RPPR module after logging into eRA Commons (select Status from the main menu) and use the module's electronic initiation capability rather than paper or separate systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic routing to authorizing officials for review and approval
rubrics_metrics.description: Route the RPPR electronically to authorizing officials at the applicant organization for review and approval prior to submission to the agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the RPPR is routed within the module to the appropriate Signing Official/authorizing official and obtain their approval before submitting to the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing RPPR routing history
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain and review the RPPR routing history within the module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the module's feature to view routing history to track who has reviewed or approved the RPPR and when.

rubrics_metrics.name: Error checking prior to submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the RPPR module's error checking capabilities to identify and resolve errors before submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run the module's error checks to catch missing or invalid information; correct errors in the RPPR forms prior to final submission to the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission of the RPPR
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit the completed RPPR electronically through the RPPR module to the agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not attempt to submit outside the module; follow the module workflow to complete submission to the Grants Management community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creation and electronic submission of Interim RPPR
rubrics_metrics.description: Create and submit Interim RPPRs using the RPPR module when required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The module supports creation and electronic submission of Interim RPPRs; follow agency-specific guidance on when an Interim RPPR is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creation and electronic submission of Final RPPR
rubrics_metrics.description: Create and submit Final RPPRs using the RPPR module when the project period ends or as otherwise required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The module supports creation and electronic submission of Final RPPRs; ensure final reports meet agency timing and content requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation of submission authority (SO to PD/PI)
rubrics_metrics.description: A Signing Official (SO) may delegate authority to a PD/PI for submitting an RPPR, except where prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the module's delegation capability to allow a PD/PI to submit on behalf of the SO when permitted. Note: Department of Commerce (DOC) awards disallow use of delegations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency-specific exceptions (DOC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Agency-specific instructions may override module features; the NIH/Other PHS RPPR Instruction Guide does not apply to DOC awards and DOC delegations cannot be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For Department of Commerce awards, follow DOC-specific guidance rather than the NIH/Other PHS RPPR Instruction Guide and do not use delegation functionality for DOC awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the NIH and Other PHS Agency RPPR Instruction Guide for Sections A–I
rubrics_metrics.description: Field-by-field guidance for completing Sections A–I of the RPPR is provided in the NIH and Other PHS Agency RPPR Instruction Guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the RPPR Instruction Guide (linked on the page) for detailed content and completion instructions for Sections A–I. This guide does not apply to DOC awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: PDF record generation and storage
rubrics_metrics.description: A PDF version of the RPPR is generated and stored in the electronic grant folder (Commons Status Information screen).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm that the module generates the PDF and that it is stored in the electronic grant folder as the official record; use the Commons Status Information screen to view the stored PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to access the RPPR module
rubrics_metrics.description: Access the RPPR module by logging into eRA Commons and selecting Status from the main menu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the described navigation steps to reach the RPPR module; this is required to initiate, edit, route, and submit RPPRs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support contact
rubrics_metrics.description: For additional assistance, contact the eRA Service Desk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the eRA Service Desk for technical or process questions related to the RPPR module and submissions.
